title: GERF: A Token-Efficient Multimodal Retrieval Framework for Schema-Guided Scientific Information Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2611.28295v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific information extraction (IE) is a fundamental component of AI for Science, transforming experimental knowledge embedded in scientific literature into structured and traceable data for evidence synthesis, scientific database construction, and data-driven discovery. However, critical experimental details are often distributed across text, tables, figures, captions, and surrounding discussion, making them difficult to recover using conventional text-only extraction. Existing LLM-based and multimodal RAG pipelines typically rely on full-document context or coarse page-level retrieval, introducing substantial irrelevant evidence and high textual and visual token costs. We propose GERF, a Graph-based Evidence Retrieval Framework for token-efficient, schema-guided multimodal scientific IE. translated_title: GERF：一种面向模式引导科学信息抽取的令牌高效多模态检索框架
translated_abstract: 科学信息抽取（IE）是“AI for Science”的基础组成部分，它将科学文献中蕴含的实验知识转化为结构化、可追溯的数据，用于证据综合、科学数据库构建和数据驱动的科学发现。然而，关键的实验细节往往分散在文本、表格、插图、图注及周围的讨论中，仅依赖文本的传统抽取方法难以完整恢复这些信息。现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）和多模态RAG的流程通常依赖全文上下文或粗糙的页面级检索，引入大量无关证据，并带来高昂的文本与视觉token成本。我们提出了GERF，一种基于图的证据检索框架，用于令牌高效、模式引导的多模态科学信息抽取。GERF将每篇文章表示为一张异构证据图，将模式字段、文本块、插图及由插图衍生的内容连接起来，从而……
tldr: 提出了GERF框架，将论文表示为连接模式字段、文本块与插图的异构证据图，实现令牌高效、模式引导的多模态科学信息抽取，显著减少无关证据并降低文本与视觉token成本。
en_tdlr: GERF is a graph-based evidence retrieval framework that represents articles as heterogeneous evidence graphs linking schema fields, text chunks, and figures, enabling token-efficient, schema-guided multimodal scientific information extraction with substantially reduced irrelevant evidence and token costs.
